rules.description: Skeleton container must have aria-busy="true" to signal loading state to screen readers
Skeleton must not contain readable text — only structural placeholder shapes
Skeleton elements must have explicit width/height to match the target component's layout
Skeleton fill must use muted/neutral colors (bg-muted, bg-gray, bg-slate) — never primary colors
Shimmer/pulse animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion via CSS media query or Tailwind motion-reduce:
Skeleton must contain zero data fetching, API calls, or prop-driven data rendering
DOM structure of skeleton must mirror the target component (list → rows, card → image+text blocks, table → rows+cols)
Container should have role="status" or role="alert" alongside aria-busy for full screen-reader compatibility
